# Open Innova

> Open innovation, custom software and process consulting for businesses and third-sector organisations.

Open Innova S.r.l. combines software development with knowledge of the third sector and organisational processes. Its purpose is to make technology useful and accessible in everyday work. The company was founded in 2026; the team's Civil Service software projects began in 2022.

**Approach.** Open Innova starts with listening and process analysis, builds solutions with their users and shares useful improvements across projects. Direct developer contact and ongoing care are central to its approach.

**Projects.** Custom management software is developed with organisations and businesses after studying their workflows; experience includes software for large football tournaments, which contributed to the BLADE technology base. GestiSCU is an example of open innovation applied to the Italian Universal Civil Service: the Open Innova website tells the collaboration story, while product marketing and features are on gestiscu.it. It is used by organisational staff, local project supervisors (OLP) and volunteers, from selection to volunteer management.

**Licensing.** Clients purchase a licence to use the software. Open Innova retains the rights to the code and can reuse useful improvements across projects. Open innovation means collaboration and shared learning, not automatically open-source code or client ownership of source code. Client data and documents are not shared through this collaboration.

**Working process.** The team listens to clients, observes workflows and visits their premises when useful. It develops a proposal with the client and then prepares a quote. Initial meetings and the work needed to prepare the quote are free of charge. Software licensing may be accompanied by training, specific adaptations, assistance and operational support; for Civil Service organisations, support can include full management of agreed activities. Scope and terms are defined with each client. Clients keep direct contact with the development team, and maintenance and improvements to security, performance and resource efficiency continue over time.

**Training.** Coaching and tutoring for volunteers can be commissioned by organisations separately from the software. Training also includes practical educational projects: an eight-day bootcamp took place in June 2026 with four vocational school students, as part of a project aimed at preventing early school leaving.

**People.** Giovanni Rende, co-founder and sole director: third-sector, Civil Service and organisational experience. Daniele Nucciarelli, co-founder: software architecture and cloud infrastructure; personal site https://daniele.nucciarelli.it. Emanuele Persichini, co-founder and full-stack developer.

**Contact.** Write to info@openinnova.it, even without a solution or specification in mind; it also covers GestiSCU and process consulting. Custom software: dev@openinnova.it. Accessibility: accessibilita@openinnova.it. Privacy: privacy@openinnova.it. Security reports: security@openinnova.it.

**Website.** Static Hugo website hosted on AWS S3 in Milan and distributed through CloudFront. No cookies, analytics, profiling tools or externally loaded fonts and libraries. It targets WCAG 2.2 level AA and is checked automatically before every release. Contact forms prepare a message in the visitor's email app; visitors send it from there. Website code is public under the repository's stated licences; brand assets, copy and company data remain protected. Environmental estimates are model-based, not measurements of individual visits.

The site is bilingual: Italian at the root, English under /en/. Links below point to the English pages; the Italian URL is given in each note.
